title: campaign-spec template variables
description: Values for templates/campaign-spec.md.j2 and templates/campaign-spec.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from campaign-spec.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

budget_model.title: Budget model
budget_model.description: Budget at ad-set level (abo) or campaign level (cbo). cbo only once you clear roughly 50 conversions per week; below that it starves the ad set that needed the data.

campaign_name.title: Campaign name
campaign_name.description: Campaign name following the naming convention below. It is the only thing that makes a report readable three months later, so build it from the convention rather than describing the idea.

conversion_event.title: Conversion event
conversion_event.description: The pixel event that counts as success - Purchase, Lead, CompleteRegistration. It must already be firing and verified before launch; an unfired event trains the algorithm on nothing.

daily_budget.title: Daily budget
daily_budget.description: Daily spend per ad set, with currency. Learning phase needs roughly 50 conversions in 7 days - if your budget divided by your CPA does not reach that, the structure is wrong, not the creative.

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: The optimisation objective. Meta optimises for exactly what you pick - choosing traffic when you want purchases buys you clicks from people who never buy, and the numbers will look fine.

primary_audience.title: Primary audience
primary_audience.description: Who the first ad set targets and where the list came from - matched customer file, 1% lookalike of purchasers, interest stack. Name the source; "our audience" cannot be rebuilt after it breaks.
